properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure AD B2C: Audit Custom Domain Configuration
properties.description: Audits that Azure AD B2C is configured with a custom domain rather than the default .b2clogin.com domain. Custom domains reduce phishing risk by presenting a recognizable organization-owned domain to end users during authentication flows. NIST IA-8 requires identification and authentication of non-organizational users through trusted channels.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance when custom domain tag is missing. Disabled: Do not evaluate. Note: B2C custom domain configuration is managed via the Azure portal and DNS, not directly enforceable via Azure Policy.
